subject: Re: NovaHealth MAP — technical acceptance & POC network items
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@novahealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-25T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: NovaHealth MAP — technical acceptance & POC network items

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for the call earlier. As discussed, attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the POC so we can lock down technical acceptance criteria and a near-term timeline. Key checklist items we need to confirm so the POC can run in your environment:

- Org + user setup (who will be invited to the Redwood org for the POC)
- Scoped API key generation and expected rotation policy for the trial
- IP allowlist entries (we will provide our egress IP blocks)
- VPC peering vs. PrivateLink: requirements and expected CIDR ranges
- Data handling: logs/retention and audit expectations for the trial

Attached: [Attachment: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)], [Attachment: novahealth-network-diagram.png (PNG, 128 KB)], and a draft SOW to scope timeline [Attachment: POC_SOW_draft.docx].

Proposed short timeline:
- Confirm MAP and owners: by 2026-04-28
- Network prep (IP allowlist, VPC peering config): by 2026-05-04
- Scoped API keys & org activation: by 2026-05-06
- POC run window: 2026-05-07 through 2026-05-21

Can you confirm the right technical contacts for networking and whether you prefer peering or a managed endpoint? If peering, please send the CIDR(s) you'd like us to accept so our infra team can start the prep.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com]
[Attachment: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.pdf]

From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@novahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mitul Rao <mitul.rao@novahealth.com>, IT Ops <itops@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-26T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth MAP — technical acceptance & POC network items

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. We're happy to move forward. A few quick notes from the infra side:

- We prefer VPC peering for the initial POC (simpler routing for our internal test VPC).
- Our networking team will need your egress IP ranges to add to our firewall allowlist. Can you provide those?
- Our preferred peer CIDR for the POC VPC is 10.50.0.0/16; we can peer from our side once Redwood confirms the target CIDR.
- For API keys: we require scoped keys with read/write separated; rotation cadence of once during the POC is fine.
- We'll need the SOW signed and a quick DSAR note on logs.

Looping in Mitul (networking) and the IT Ops mailbox — Mitul, can you coordinate an afternoon slot next week (May 4 or May 5) for a short peering reachability test?

Regards,
Sasha Patel
Head of Partnerships, NovaHealth
[sasha.patel@novahealth.com]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mitul Rao <mitul.rao@novahealth.com>, Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@novahealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: NovaHealth MAP — technical acceptance & POC network items

Hi all —

Thanks for the details, Sasha. A few technical clarifications and what we'll deliver from our side:

1) Egress IPs: we will provide a short list of NAT egress IPs (3 IPs) for your firewall. Those are non-rotating for the POC window; we will publish them by EOD 2026-04-28 and request you add them to allowlist.

2) VPC peering: peering works for low-latency test traffic. Redwood will accept peering into the following recommended CIDR for the POC endpoint: 10.20.0.0/16. If that collides with your addressing, let us know.

3) Route tables / security: after peering, please ensure the route table in the NovaHealth VPC points 10.20.0.0/16 to the peering connection and that your security groups allow outbound 443 to our endpoint. We will not request inbound access to your internal services.

4) API keys: we will create a scoped API key labelled "novahealth-poc-2026" with token-lifetime tied to the POC dates. Keys will be created once the NovaHealth org is invited and an admin confirms. For audit, we can supply an event log excerpt showing key issuance (no payloads).

5) DSAR/log retention: by default logs for the POC are retained for 30 days; we can produce an export on request.

Attachments: I attached a small network diagram we suggest [Attachment: novahealth-network-diagram.png].

Next steps (technical):
- Redwood posts egress IPs (by 2026-04-28)
- NovaHealth adds allowlist & confirms peering slot (Mitul)
- Redwood generates scoped API key after org invite (target 2026-05-06)

Happy to hop on a short call with Mitul next week to run the peering test — I have availability May 4, 10:00–12:00 PT.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[dev.patel@redwoodinference.com]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@novahealth.com>, Mitul Rao <mitul.rao@novahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-29T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: RE: NovaHealth MAP — technical acceptance & POC network items

Hi Sasha / Mitul —

I wanted to add the operational checklist we will run on our side to make the org + API onboarding smooth: 

- Create Redwood org: "novahealth-redwood-poc" and invite your two admins (please share emails).
- Assign roles: Admin (full access) + Dev (limited).
- Issue scoped API key (novahealth-poc-2026) once admin accepts invite.
- Provide QA checklist for sample calls (curl examples + payloads) and an internal test endpoint for smoke tests.
- Coordinate a short health-check call immediately after peering (15–20 min).

Proposed timeline update:
- 2026-04-28: Redwood egress IPs posted (Dev) — on track
- 2026-05-04: VPC peering & reachability test (Mitul + Dev)
- 2026-05-05: Org invites sent (Lauren)
- 2026-05-06: Scoped API key issued & sample calls verified
- 2026-05-07: POC data ingest begins

If that aligns with your schedule, Jordan and I will mark these milestones in the MAP and push the SOW for signatures. Also tagging Markus for any pricing/contract notes.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com]

From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@novahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mitul Rao <mitul.rao@novahealth.com>, IT Ops <itops@novahealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth MAP — technical acceptance & POC network items

Jordan / team —

All good from our side. Mitul confirmed the 10.50.0.0/16 peer CIDR and we'll schedule the peering test on May 4 at 10:30 AM PT. Mitul will request the egress IP list from your infra team; Dev, please post those by EOD 4/28 as planned.

We will accept the org invite and have our two admins (me and Mitul) onboarded. Once the scoped API key is issued, we will run the sample calls and confirm by 2026-05-06. SOW looks fine — I will route to legal but expect no blockers for signature.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — excited to get the POC started.

Best,
Sasha Patel
Head of Partnerships, NovaHealth
[sasha.patel@novahealth.com]
